resources.string: Performs Orison\'s pointer clicks in any app and draws its floating bar (bubble, side bar or island) so it does not disappear. It does not read the screen content or store anything, except where you left the bar.
Grabbed. Take the pointer to the destination and tap to drop.
Drag: put the pointer over what you want to grab and tap.
Orison island. Tap the circle side to dictate or the arrow side to open the pointer
Orison island. Tap to open the pointer
Since it was turned on: %1$s clicks requested by Orison · %2$s done · %3$s interrupted · %4$s rejected.
✗ Android cancelled the gesture. Turn Orison Pointer off and on again in Accessibility.
✗ Android said it performed the gesture, but the button did not receive the touch.
✗ Android rejected the gesture. Turn Orison Pointer off and on again in Accessibility.
✗ The service is not running. Turn it on in Accessibility (if it is already on, turn it off and on again).
Sensitivity, pointer style and trackpad shape are adjusted in Orison › Settings › Trackpad.

A pointer that reaches the whole screen, including the part your finger can no longer reach. It works alone or with Orison: it performs its trackpad\'s clicks and draws its floating bar (bubble, side bar or island). It does not read what is on the screen; it only remembers where you left the bar.
Done: next time it opens in its usual place
Put the trackpad back in its place
If Android says “Restricted setting”: open the app info, tap ⋮ at the top right and choose “Allow restricted settings”. Then go back to Accessibility.
Active. The pointer clicks already work.
Turned on in Accessibility, but Android did not start it. Turn it off and on again.
In Accessibility, choose “Orison Pointer” and turn it on.
Open the trackpad from the Orison bar or from its own tab: tap is a click, press and hold is a long click.
To use the trackpad without Orison: a small tab on the edge of the screen opens it.
The Orison bar (with its pointer) is showing now. The tab appears when you turn that bar off.
Tap the tab to open the trackpad. Drag it to move it; take it to the center and it becomes a bubble.
Tap “Test”: Orison Pointer will tap the “Target” button by itself, as it would with the trackpad.
✓ Android performed the click. The pointer can tap in other apps.
In the free window: drag the top line to move it and the bottom-right corner to make it bigger or smaller. It remembers where you left it, so it always stays in the healthy part of the screen.
Slide to move · Tap to click
Trackpad surface. Slide to move the pointer, tap to click.
